executiveSummary: Federal authorities warned of active AI-assisted exploitation against Siemens S7 PLCs in U.S. critical infrastructure, with reported degradation of some water operations. The advisory highlights AI-generated exploitation scripts disguised as monitoring tools and urges urgent review of exposure and incident readiness. Source Social-engineering risk remained high: a cybersecurity firm confirmed a vishing-led intrusion attempt involving credential capture and fake SSO pages, and the FBI warned about AI-generated voice/text impersonation of senior U.S. officials. View Article Security Advisory In parallel, platforms and standards advanced authenticity defenses: Android introduced fake-call protections, Anthropic disclosed model-level watermarking plans, OpenAI expanded SynthID audio provenance, NIST launched a tougher deepfake benchmark, and C2PA issued new implementation guidance. View Article Source Supporting Report Vendor Advisory Standards Guidance Criminal usage persisted from explicit-content extortion to large-scale scam centers leveraging GenAI for multilingual lures and persona management, underscoring global victimization risk across adults and minors. Industrial/OT: Implement strict network segmentation for PLCs; remove internet exposure; monitor for anomalous engineering workstation activity. (Analyst Recommendation)
Identity/MFA: Enforce help-desk callback and manager approval for MFA resets; prefer phishing-resistant FIDO2 for high-risk roles. (Analyst Recommendation)
Voice threats: Adopt out-of-band verification for financial or data requests; evaluate handset and UC tools that flag suspected synthetic audio. (Analyst Recommendation)
Provenance: Enable C2PA Content Credentials where supported; retain invisible watermarking metadata in media pipelines. (Analyst Recommendation)
Forensics: Preserve original media with metadata; collect call audio and signaling data for deepfake-source tracing and benchmark against NIST datasets where feasible. (Analyst Recommendation)
Awareness: Train staff that human hearing is unreliable for detecting partial audio deepfakes; require callbacks and dual control for high-value actions. (Analyst Recommendation)
